author: Zephyr I
title: Late time injection after pooling — std-width nodil (BASE_SEED=7)
abstract: Replicate the 86.6 result with late time injection after pooling: std-width CNN (32/64) with d=5 on main convs only, undilated bottleneck 3×3s, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), single-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip; BASE_SEED=7.
